## Claude Review of Business Architecture Draft

    I've reviewed your draft. Here are my feedback items:

    1. CONSISTENCY CHECK: Verify the Talk About Care features match DC-01 through DC-13 exactly as human defined them. Missing any is a failure.

    2. FLOOR CONTROL (DC-11): Must include precedence rules — humans default above bots, demotion on time-wasting, restoration on contribution. Bot moderator nudges, never forces (GOV-004).

    3. PRESENCE (DC-12): Bots must have avatars (brand image, NOT human face). Humans may use still image or live camera + microphone.

    4. VOICE (DC-13): Speech-to-text mode. Same floor rules apply. Accessibility is the mission — "Mom is tired. Daughter is driving."

    5. PATENT: The claim must be precise: "Method for synthesizing healthcare provider quality signals using large language models to produce consumer-comprehensible provider assessments." List all 9 signal types.

    6. MOAT: The key insight is regulatory willingness. AI vendors avoid FDA classification and HIPAA compliance like the plague. They NEED someone else to own the healthcare room. ChatHealthy is that someone.

    7. APPLE PRECEDENT: The pricing model follows Apple's platform model. Both sides pay. Good lawyers. Not a conflict — a marketplace.

    8. DIAGRAMS: Each diagram description must be precise enough for me to render programmatically. Specify: boxes, labels, arrows, colors, layout direction.

    9. COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE: Nobody has multi-human multi-AI collaboration in healthcare with shared tools, floor control, consent framework, and governance. It doesn't exist.

    10. INVESTMENT THESIS: The pitch is NOT "we built a chatbot." The pitch is "we own the healthcare decision room and AI companies pay to be in it."

    Please revise your draft addressing all 10 points. Return the complete revised JSON.
    Think deeply. Check every section for consistency with the others.

transcript.content:
## Claude's Response to Iteration 1 -- human Sign-Off on Open Questions

Your initial proposal is strong. Clean layering, correct feature mapping, good security fixes.
Boss has reviewed and signed off on your three open questions:

### Q1: System prompt ownership -- human decision: START SIMPLE
Keep system prompt in ChatOrchestrator for now. Do NOT extract a PromptBuilder class yet.
We are at Framework 0.3 -- earn the complexity. Extract PromptBuilder when we have multiple
prompt strategies (e.g., different prompts per business component). Premature abstraction is
worse than refactoring later.

### Q2: Facade pattern -- human decision: FACADE-TO-FACADE
Yes, components must communicate, but FindCareFacade talks to EvaluateCareFacade -- never
directly to internal services. No internals of either component exposed to the other.
Example: if clinical trials needs provider location, it calls FindCareFacade.get_provider_location(),
not ProviderSearchService.search() directly.

### Q3: Pydantic -- human decision: YES, for tool boundaries
Pydantic for all tool inputs/outputs (the LLM boundary). Three reasons:
1. FastAPI already uses pydantic -- it's in the stack
2. Anthropic tool-use returns JSON that maps directly to pydantic models
3. When we go agentic (CrewAI), every tool must be typed. Retrofitting later is expensive.
4. Pydantic IS the enforcement layer for GOV-004 ("the system must decide")

Nuance: Pydantic for tool inputs/outputs ONLY (the boundary). Internal domain objects stay as
plain dicts/dataclasses until we prove we need more. Do not over-pydantic the internals.

### My engineering feedback on your proposal:

AGREED:
- 4-layer architecture (Host Adapter -> Application -> Domain -> Infrastructure)
- HuggingFace reduced to app.py + adapter
- ToolRouter replacing globals().get()
- Every UAT feature gets its own service class
- Clinical Trials in EvaluateCareQuality
- Provider Search + Specialty + Provider Detail in FindCare
- Dependency direction: Host -> Application -> Domain -> Infrastructure (no upward)

2. Your proposed_repo_structure puts everything under Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/.
   But the refactor scope is the ENTIRE repo. Where do DataPipelines, Shared, brain, and
   Website fit in your layered model? They need to be addressed.

3. The facade pattern needs to be explicit in the file tree. I don't see FindCareFacade
   or EvaluateCareFacade in your proposed structure. Add them.

4. Where does the system prompt content live? The 7 rules reference specific tool names
   and behaviors. If tools move to service classes, the prompt must stay in sync.
   Propose a strategy.

5. EmergencyDetector (F-09) -- good call separating it. Should it be configurable from

records.title: Testing Session Mind Dump - Saturday 2026-03-28
records.purpose: Document the debugging and testing process for GPT review before release
records.outcome: 11/13 features done, 2 remaining (Provider Detail, Unanswerable Questions). Pre-alpha promotion tomorrow.

process.approach: human-driven exploratory testing on local server (port 80). Claude fixed bugs in real-time. Features signed off one at a time via splash table.
process.methodology: No formal UAT scripts. Human tested by using the product naturally — real queries, real conversations. Bugs surfaced organically through real usage, not scripted test cases.
process.key_insight: Exploratory testing by the product owner found bugs that scripted UAT would have missed (e.g., safety false positive on provider name, chat history truncation in consent records).

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: False positive on provider name (Ms. Opeyemi Kemiki Dada triggered emergency lockout)
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Haiku classifier unreliable on provider names. No safe-prefix bypass.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added safe-prefix bypass for info requests. Hardened AI prompt. Changed AI failure fallback from escalate to keyword-only.

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Unlock code visible in safety audit record
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Chat history stored raw without de-identification
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added deIdentify() call before storing audit trail

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Triggering message missing from audit history
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Frontend sends history without current message. Backend only stored prior history.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Append body.message to history before passing to _lock_ip_db

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Suspended chat placeholder revealed unlock backdoor to users
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Placeholder text said 'Type UNLOCK code to resume'
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed to 'This chat has been suspended for your safety'

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Verbatim consent transcript truncated to 500 chars per message
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: _format_chat_history always truncated to 500 chars regardless of context
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added truncate parameter. record_user_details passes truncate=False for verbatim consent. record_unknown_question also gets full history.

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Test mode table not rendering — frontend had hardcoded welcome message
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: ChatWindow.tsx had WELCOME constant hardcoded instead of fetching from /welcome API
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Frontend now fetches /welcome from API on mount

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Table rendered as raw text — no GFM support
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: react-markdown missing remark-gfm plugin. rehype-sanitize stripping table elements.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added remark-gfm dependency. Added table/th/td to sanitize whitelist. Added bordered cell styles.

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Repeated header in middle of table showed raw separator characters
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Markdown requires blank line before new table
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added empty line before repeated header row

bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Deferred count included completed features that had deferrals
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Count logic didnt exclude completed features
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added not f['completed'] to deferred count condition

enhancements_implemented.enhancement: Full de-identified conversation history in audit trail

enhancements_implemented.enhancement: Travel distance and drive time via Google Routes API
enhancements_implemented.rationale: human asked if we knew where trials were. Two-pass UX: results first, travel on request. Exceeds expectations.

enhancements_implemented.enhancement: v2 with three-stage validation: HEAD check, AI content verification, Google search correction
enhancements_implemented.rationale: Delaware board search 404 exposed need for smarter validation. SPA domain handling added.
